svg.title: Same settings, two sampler orders
svg.desc: Next-token probabilities from qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M after the text '…down to the rocks with a'. Top five at temperature 1, over the full vocabulary: ' lantern' 0.304, ' torch' 0.081, ' bucket' 0.050, ' flashlight' 0.049, ' rope' 0.021. Panel A (blue, the Hugging Face order) applies temperature 0.7 first, then top-k 15 and top-p 0.9: 4 tokens survive. Panel B (orange, the llama.cpp order) applies top-k 15 and top-p 0.9 first and temperature 0.7 last: 9 tokens survive. The word the passage actually continues with, 'lamp', is rank 8: cut in A, kept in B. Survivors are coloured in their panel's colour, cut tokens are grey. Same probabilities, same settings, different survivor sets.
